parameters.formTitle: Profit Leak Analyzer — Analyze CSV Files
parameters.formDescription: =Upload your order, shipment, and courier settlement CSV files to identify outstanding receivables, reconciliation discrepancies, and settlement exceptions. How it works: Upload your CSV files, provide the analysis date, and select Analyze CSV Files. Your reconciliation summary and detailed financial dashboard will be available after processing. Demo safety: Use synthetic demonstration data only. Do not upload real customer, merchant, or banking information. This demo is not authenticated.

options.instructions: You map CSV column headers to canonical field names. You only ever see headers and field descriptions, never data. Return only mappings you are confident about; otherwise use canonical_field UNMAPPED. Each canonical field may be used at most once per source_type.

nodeGroups.name: Check uploaded files
nodeGroups.description: Rejects malformed, unreadable or missing CSVs as failed imports; headers-only files are allowed as zero records

nodeGroups.name: Log rejected import
nodeGroups.description: Stores the run as FAILED_IMPORT with each file error and shows them to the uploader

nodeGroups.name: Map file columns
nodeGroups.description: Matches headers by rules, then cache, then AI (headers only, no row values); keeps original money text

nodeGroups.name: Analyze and save results
nodeGroups.description: Runs the integer-paisa engine (crash = FAILED_ENGINE), stores all four result sets, then reads them back

nodeGroups.name: Confirm and finish run
nodeGroups.description: Only marks COMPLETED when stored counts and IDs match engine output; otherwise FAILED_PERSISTENCE
